column2: How do I see the people linked to each document in the Documents list?
column3: In the “📄 Documents” tab, the left column writes under each document’s title the names of the linked people (“Jean MAZAUD, Marie LACOMBE +3” when there are more), then its kind, date and place. “⋯” next to “A → Z” chooses what you read under the title: everything (recommended), the people, or the date and place. “👤 By person” files the documents under each person’s name (surname then first name, with the index letters to jump); a document linked to several people is under each of them, and those with no person go to “No person”. “Search…” also finds a document by a person’s name. Right-click a document to open it, edit it, download it or open a person’s record. In view-only mode, living people and confidential records are not named.
